name: sovereign-harz-storage-ruling-20261009
description: Rabiu's ruling (Oct 9 2026): Cloudflare R2 becomes optional transport adapter, not dependency. HARZ Vault = storage authority, nodes = replaceable capacity, 3-verified-copy replication after durable core, Search/D1 stays index. Stage 1 protect corpus MANDATORY, Vault v0.1 approved, migration proven before switch, originals kept, unrestricted ingestion rejected. Canonical text.
content:
{
  "name": "Sovereign HARZ Storage Ruling",
  "issued": "2026-10-09 by Rabiu",
  "principle": "HARZ may use external infrastructure, but no external provider may control HARZ's ability to preserve, retrieve, verify, or move its own knowledge.",
  "architecture": {
    "harz_vault": "authority: durable storage record is the truth, not ingestion success; stable content hash, verifiable location, dedup identity, recoverable ingestion state",
    "storage_nodes": "replaceable capacity across independently operated machines/devices; no node is a single point of failure; eligibility by storage/integrity/availability requirements",
    "replication": "3 verified copies for critical docs (initial target, capacity permitting); ack follows durable storage; hash verification; resumable transfers; honest degraded-availability reporting",
    "search": "HARZ Search/D1 remains the searchable index; Vault defines document identity; search must not know whether a doc is local-node, remote-node, or cloud-adapter; local docs readable offline"
  },
  "rulings_table": {
    "r2_as_prerequisite": "REJECTED",
    "cloudflare_as_optional_adapter": "ACCEPTED",
    "preserve_existing_d1_corpus": "MANDATORY",
    "build_harz_vault": "APPROVED",
    "offline_retrieval_core": "MANDATORY",
    "distributed_replication": "AFTER durable core passes",
    "move_entire_corpus_immediately": "REJECTED",
    "unrestricted_ingestion": "REJECTED"
  },
  "stages": {
    "1_protect": "record counts/hashes/cursor/usage; verified backup or export; measure capacity; ingestion within safe limits",
    "2_vault_v01": "content-addressed storage, durable writes+recovery, manifest, idempotent resumable ingestion, integrity verification, provider-independent interface, honest LIVE/CACHED/OFFLINE/STALE",
    "3_prove_migration": "test corpus through both systems; no missing/altered/duplicated docs; cursor continuation; restart recovery; offline retrieval; resumable and reversible; originals kept"
  },
  "hard_truth": "Storage requires physical capacity somewhere. The architecture must be capacity-aware from the beginning. Sovereignty = controlling the trade-offs, not hiding them."
}
